entities.summary: Yassıada, officially renamed Democracy and Freedom Island in 2013, is one of the Princes' Islands in the Sea of Marmara, to the southeast of Istanbul. In Byzantine times, it was known as Plati. It should not be confused with Yassi Ada, a different island in the Aegean Sea.
